cards.audioText: Your call sign is SIA233. Stand 215, from Wuhan to Singapore, information B. Request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是新航233，215号机位，从武汉飞往新加坡，通播B，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA233, Stand 215, information B, destination Singapore, request ATC clearance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，新航233，215号机位，通播B，目的地新加坡，向ATC申请放行至新加坡。

cards.audioText: SIA233, Wuhan Delivery cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，武汉放行，可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, LKO-01 departure, initial climb 1800m, cruising level 10400m, runway 36R, departure frequency 119.7, squawk 6325, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行至新加坡，LKO-01离场，起始高度1800米，巡航高度10400米，跑道36右，离场频率119.7，应答机6325, 新航233。

cards.audioText: You are now ready, contact Ground to request pushback and start-up.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在准备好了，联系地面，请求推出开车
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA233, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航233，请求推出开车。

cards.audioText: SIA233, Wuhan Ground, pushback and startup approved, facing east.
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，武汉地面，同意推出开车，面朝东。
cards.referenceText: Pushback and startup approved, facing east, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意推出开车，面朝东，新航233。

cards.audioText: While taxiing, you notice the wind sock shows a strong tailwind, contact Tower to check the wind.
cards.audioTextZh: 滑行时，你注意到风袋显示有强烈顺风，联系塔台检查风向风速。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233, request wind check.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，证实风向风速。

cards.audioText: SIA233, surface wind 220 degrees, 8m/s.[The tailwind exceeds your takeoff limit. Contact Tower to change to runway 18L and state the reason.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，地面风220，8米/秒。【该风速超过你的起飞限制。联系塔台更换至跑道18左并说明原因。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233, the tailwind exceeds our takeoff limit, request runway 18L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，该风速超过我们的起飞限制，请求更换跑道18左。
武汉地面，新航233，听你指挥。

cards.audioText: SIA233, taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, F.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Taxi to holding point runway 18L via E, D4, and F, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 沿滑行道E，D4，F滑至跑道18左的等待点，新航233。

cards.audioText: After you pass taxiway E, you saw a cone lying on the taxiway D4, tell the controller what you have seen.
cards.audioTextZh: 滑过滑行道E后，你看到滑行道D4上有一个路障，告诉管制员你看到的情况。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA233, there is a cone lying on the taxiway D4 and it blocks my taxiway. Request assistance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，新航233，滑行道D4上有一个路障，它堵住了我的滑行道。请求援助。

cards.audioText: SIA233, roger that. Hold present position.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，收到。原地等待。【复诵】

cards.audioText: You have departed from runway 18L, shortly after liftoff, you encountered a bird strike, your right engine has failed, make an urgency call, request maintain runway heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已在跑道18左起飞，起飞后不久，飞机遭到了鸟击，右侧发动机失效，做紧急呼叫，请求保持跑道航向。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Tower, SIA233, right engine failure due bird strike, request maintain runway heading.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN，武汉塔台，新航233，由于鸟击，右侧发动机失效，请求保持跑道航向。

cards.audioText: Tell the tower you want to dump fuel and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 【告诉塔台你想放油之后返回武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233 request fuel dumping and return to Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，请求放油，之后返回武汉机场。

cards.audioText: SIA 233, Tower, roger PANPAN, turn right heading 240, intercept LKO VOR 30 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，塔台，收到PANPAN，右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Right heading 240, intercept LKO 030 radial inbound, climb and maintain 3000m, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向240，切入LKO VOR向台30度径向线，上升保持3000米，新航233。

cards.audioText: SIA233, after passing LKO, left heading 220, maintain 3000m, report over LKO.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: After passing LKO, left heading 220, maintaining 3000m, report over LKO, SIA233.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞过LKO后，左转航向220，3000米保持，过LKO报告，新航233。

cards.audioText: You are over LKO, call Wuhan Control.
SIA233, advise the time required for fuel jettison.[Tell Wuhan Control you need approximately 25 min.]
cards.audioTextZh: 新航233，报告放油需要的时间。【告诉武汉区调你需要大约25分钟。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们需要大约25分钟，新航233。

cards.audioText: Tell Wuhan Approach fuel dumping is now completed, request radar vectors for runway 22.
cards.audioTextZh: 告诉武汉进近放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, SIA233, fuel dumping completed, request radar vector runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，新航233，放油完成，请求雷达引导至跑道22。

cards.audioText: You are now established on ILS approach runway 22, contact Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 你已经建立盲降进近跑道22，联系塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA233, established ILS approach runway 22.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，新航233，建立盲降进近跑道22。
